errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Only the configured authority may perform this action.

errors.name: InvalidConfig
errors.msg: Protocol configuration is invalid.

errors.name: InvalidModel
errors.msg: Model metadata or cipher format is invalid.

errors.name: ModelNotUploading
errors.msg: The model is not uploading.

errors.name: ModelNotSealed
errors.msg: Seal the model before granting it.

errors.name: ModelNotLive
errors.msg: The model does not accept new calls.

errors.name: InvalidWeights
errors.msg: The weights accounts do not match the model.

errors.name: InvalidWrite
errors.msg: The upload has a gap or an out-of-range write.

errors.name: UploadIncomplete
errors.msg: Every weights byte must be written before sealing.

errors.name: CiphertextHashMismatch
errors.msg: The ciphertext hash does not match.

errors.name: InvalidAttestation
errors.msg: The attestation record is invalid or expired.

errors.name: MeasurementNotAllowed
errors.msg: The enclave measurement is not allowed by this model.

errors.name: InvalidEnclave
errors.msg: The enclave registration does not match its attestation.

errors.name: InvalidWrappedKey
errors.msg: The wrapped key must be a version 1 envelope of 105 bytes.

errors.name: GrantRequired
errors.msg: The enclave does not hold an active grant.

errors.name: CallNotOpen
errors.msg: The call has already settled or been refunded.

errors.name: CallDeadlinePassed
errors.msg: The call settlement deadline has passed.

errors.name: CallNotRefundable
errors.msg: The call deadline has not passed.

errors.name: InvalidSignature
errors.msg: The required Ed25519 verification instruction is missing or does not match.

errors.name: InvalidTokenAccount
errors.msg: The escrow mint or token accounts are invalid.

errors.name: InvalidRecipient
errors.msg: A payment recipient does not match the call snapshot.

errors.name: InsufficientEscrow
errors.msg: The escrow cannot cover the requested payment.

errors.name: ArithmeticOverflow
errors.msg: An arithmetic limit was exceeded.

errors.name: InvalidOpenAnswer
errors.msg: The open answer bytes are empty, exceed the configured limit, or do not match the output hash.

errors.name: InvalidCallback
errors.msg: The callback specification or remaining accounts are invalid.

errors.name: InvalidCall
errors.msg: The call pricing unit or escrow ceiling is invalid for this instruction.

errors.name: InvalidMeasurement
errors.msg: The measurement digest, source metadata, or status is invalid.

errors.name: InvalidPolicy
errors.msg: The model policy limits, callers, operators, or regions are invalid.

errors.name: PolicyCallerDenied
errors.msg: The caller is not on this model's allow list.

errors.name: PolicyOperatorDenied
errors.msg: The enclave operator is not allowed by this model's policy.

errors.name: PolicyRequired
errors.msg: This model has an active policy; pass its Policy account in remaining accounts.

errors.name: InvalidQuote
errors.msg: The quoted operator share exceeds the model's maximum operator share.
